title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Chozhan shares his success with Nila as he gifts her gold bangles. Pandian and Pallavan praise his growth while Chozhan video calls Thenmozhi to happily show-off the gift.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
description: Thangaraj warns Ragavan about Lakshmi, who gets scolded but remains firm on her movie plan. She convinces Revathi to join, while Malar and Mathi urge her to stay calm.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: Rajangam's family visits Vellathai as Doctor Nesan completes eye surgeries. While the public asks forgiveness, Sethupathi learns high sugar puts Vellathai's sight at risk.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Pooja falsely claims she loves no one when Shankar questions her about her love life. Elsewhere, Madhu rejects Shyam's invitation to a candlelight dinner arranged for her birthday.

title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Kanmani grows emotional as Anbu lovingly talks to her baby bump, while the baby kicks in response. Vennila blames Mayuri for her missing money and accuses her of theft.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: Abhi creates trouble over the dirty bathroom, compelling Shanmugam to clean it. Deivaanai is furious with the family for failing to inform her about Shanmugam's wedding.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Gomathi is delighted by her family's unexpected arrival at the wedding. Pandian happily ties the knot with her, and the couple receives blessings from their loved ones.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Muthu is left puzzled by the drivers quitting their jobs and the cancellation of a major corporate order. Meanwhile, Ragu continues scheming against his business.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Vethanayagam and Kalyani console Sandhya after Vetri rejects her. Later, Abinaya defends Vetri against Sarala, leaving an emotional Vetri to thank her for the support.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: Mayandi pushes Azhagar to take up farming tasks despite his irresponsible behaviour. Meanwhile, Thennavan lures Senthamizh deeper into his love trap with sweet words.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Paraman wins the Panchayat election and takes charge. Siddharth clashes with him when he tries to beat Nalini, while an honoured Ilamathi opens the new Panchayat office.
